The Squirrels have a lovely day sailing on the water, when they encounter the Pirate Penguins.
Roly is digging in the garden when his spade suddenly hits something. It's a key. But what does it do?
Duggee's uniform is getting old and worn out. It's time he made himself a new outfit.
Mole feels sad that he couldn't pursue his childhood dream of being a stunt mole because his vision is so fuzzy. Can Duggee help?

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Being Quiet Badge
lista.descripcion: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn’t like noise.
The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum, so Duggee and the Squirrels need to do some detective work to reunite them with their real mum.
Super-speedy Numberblock Eighteen discovers a faster way to add a number together lots of times. Learn how multiplication works with the Numberblocks.
Super-rectangle Twelve helps the super-excited Numberblobs work out how many tokens they need for each fairground ride. Learn about multiplication with the Numberblocks.
One and friends can only escape from the Lair of Shares by learning how to share and solving the puzzles inside. Find out about sharing and division with the Numberblocks.
They came from outer space to divide the Numberblocks into Twos. Who can stop the invasion of division with the Numberblocks.
Three invites the others to her super new go-kart track, where you must divide into Threes to drive. Learn how division works with the Numberblocks.
Twenty and chums find out what happens when you go past bus stop 20. Learn about the numbers 21, 22 and 23 with the Numberblocks.
Albert Einstein's prize is missing and the clues point to everyone aboard the Peg + Cat Express!
Pato se engancha al móvil, Pocoyó y Elly, preocupados porque ya no quiere ni jugar con ellos harán lo imposible por desengancharlo. ¿Qué pasará, lo lograrán?
Pocoyo finds a remote that can increase or decrease the size of things, but his friends get angry when he leaves their stuff either big or small.
Elly wants Pocoyo and Pato to paint a portrait of her new doll, but the boys end up painting portraits of her body parts instead, angering Elly.
Pocoyo and Pato open up a supermarket (with bottles, cartons, and cans) but Elly keeps ordering too much stuff, tiring out the boys.
Elly builds a new playhouse but when Pocoyo and Pato unintentionally destroy it, they help Elly rebuild it.
En el cole, Bluey y sus amigos se enfrascan en diversos juegos. Calipso, la profe, tiene a raya a los niños con sus palabras sabias y una canción… A todos excepto a Pretzel.

A Honey le toca esperar a que la atienda la doctora Bingo, porque pasan antes otros pacientes con problemas más emocionantes. Bluey, la recepcionista, le dice que tenga paciencia, porque algunos de los casos son un problema gordo.
Como Bluey y Bingo son incapaces de coger un regalo con la garra de la máquina, sus padres crean su propia versión en casa. Sin embargo, su padre no les va a dejar ganar fácilmente.

Cuando Bluey va al mercadillo con los cinco dólares que le ha dejado el ratoncito Pérez, las opciones son infinitas. Sin embargo, cuando recorre los puestos con Indy en busca de la compra perfecta, ve que elegir no es tan fácil.

Bluey, Bingo y sus padres juegan a que sus manos son personajes. Quieren explorar las tierras que hay al otro lado de las Montañas Azules. Las chicas tienen que ser más listas que el zorro caradura para llegar a las camas más blanditas del mundo.

Mientras preparan las cosas de la piscina, Bluey y su padre se burlan de su madre porque les da la lata con lo que tienen que llevar. Sin embargo, cuando llegan ven que les falta de todo y que un poco de planificación da mucho de sí.

lista.titulo: Puffin Rock - Silky and the Octopus
lista.descripcion: Silky and Oona encounter a strange creature with eight arms during an underwater adventure.

lista.titulo: Pregunte a los StoryBots - ¿Qué pasa dentro de un volcán?
lista.descripcion: Los StoryBots ayudan al líder de un musical subterráneo a lidiar con las presiones de la fama. David Koechner aparece como estrella invitada como un pirata.

lista.titulo: Los Octonautas en tierra firme - Cold Snap
lista.descripcion: The weather’s starting to freeze, but the critters aren’t ready for the cold!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - New Mail Engine in Town
lista.descripcion: After Percy gets in an accident and ends up with a broken axle, Nia temporarily takes over his mail delivery duties for him - and her mail delivery is even quicker! Percy thinks the replacement is permanent.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Hot Air Percy
lista.descripcion: Thomas and Percy are excited to deliver a special balloon for the hot-air balloon festival, but the balloon is wrapped up tight. They're instructed not to peek at it until they arrive. While making the delivery, part of the balloon pops out of its tarp and the wind carries it skyward, along with Percy.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Carly's Screechy Squeak
lista.descripcion: Carly has developed a terrible squeak, and Sandy finds an oil can to give her a feel-good surprise, but when she tries to make the fix bigger and bigger, she creates a wacky robot oil can squirter.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Blackout!
lista.descripcion: After a huge storm hits the Island of Sodor, the power gets cut out. Thomas is tasked to deliver the generator to Knapford Station without getting stuck, but chooses to not get help from any of his friends.
Simon and Gaspard play superheroes while their mom makes a galaxy mobile.

lista.titulo: Simón - ¡Es la hora de tu baño, Elvis!
lista.descripcion: The boys want to help Grandpa give Elvis the dog a bath.

Simón construye un castillo con Fernando, pero Gaspar lo rompe accidentalmente. A la hora de comer, Fernando se va a casa y Simón está deseando volver a verle. Pero cuando se entera de que Gaspar va a reunirse con sus dos amigos, Simón teme que rompan sus juguetes. Así que invita a los tres pequeños a jugar al escondite con él. Al final, se divierten tanto juntos que, cuando Fernando regresa, se une al grupo.

lista.titulo: Robocar Poli - It's Good to Tidy Up
lista.descripcion: It's Spooky's day off, and he really wants someone to come over and play. But because his place is so messy, nobody wants to go.

lista.titulo: Robocar Poli - I'm Going to Do Whatever I Want
lista.descripcion: Bruny wants to do things his way and ignore the safety rules. But after he gets stuck in a tree, he might be ready to change his tune.
Envious of his friends, Helly trades his propeller for wheels. But when Camp needs a helicopter rescue, Helly sees why flying is so important.
El mundo de Luna · Series Infantiles
El mundo de Luna · Series Infantiles

lista.titulo: Jorge El curioso - Loch Ness Monkey
lista.descripcion: George try to find out who took the stash of acorns from Jumpy Squirrel; George is interested about the Loch Ness monster after visiting the Man With the Yellow Hat's uncle.
Los Fixis · 2013 · Series Infantiles

Tom Thomas accidentally drops his mom's wedding ring down the drain and thinks it is gone forever until Simka and Nolik help him retrieve the ring from the drain trap with the help of a pack-o-mat. Insert 1: How does a drain trap work? Insert 2: What is a pack-o-mat?
Tom Thomas has to return a DVD he borrowed from his friend but discovers his player can't read the disc anymore. Simka and Nolik help Tom Thomas clean it so it works again.

Tom Thomas' old alarm clock breaks. Papus and Nolik go to fix it but end up in the trash can together with the old clock. Insert 1: The dump - a dangerous place for Fixies Insert 2: How does an alarm-clock work?
Hank quisiera vivir como Gran Camión y sus amigos animales, pero se da cuenta de que echaría de menos muchas cosas, entre ellas, ¡la comida sin moho!

lista.titulo: Dr. Seuss: Pez rojo, pez azul - Loose/Tight + Gather/Scatter + Catch/Let Go + Relax/Stressed
lista.descripcion: The friends try on Halloween costumes, work together to clean up leaves, and try to catch a colorful butterfly - then they find some time to unwind!

lista.titulo: Dora, la exploradora - Dora's Easter Adventure
lista.descripcion: Swiper’s up to no good again and Dora, Boots and their new friend the Hip-Hop Bunny must stop him.
El alcalde se roba un antiguo pergamino que contiene los secretos del cachorro fu, y el equipo lo sigue a su guarida secreta para recuperar la reliquia.

While playing on the shore Leo, Tig and Mila have found an egg. Having figured out that a bird has lost it somehow, the friends set to hatch out the discovery. Soon not at all a chick, but a little webbed-paw turtle pips from the egg.
Before his big show, the Great Bubblini is bursting to know how bubbles form. Bang heads to the laundromat to find out. Josh Gad guest-stars.
A Bluey y a sus amigos les encanta jugar a las tiendas… ¡Si es que consiguen empezar! Como Bluey cuestiona todas las reglas y cambia a los personajes, se pueden estar aquí todo el día.

Bluey está deseando llegar a los columpios. Su padre las lleva a Bingo y a ella en un carro hasta el parque, pero pone a prueba la paciencia de Bluey porque se para todo el rato a charlar con otros adultos.
Bluey tiene un taxi. El primer pasajero es un empresario, su padre, que tiene que llegar a toda prisa al aeropuerto. Sin embargo, se producen varios retrasos inesperados y podría perder el avión.
Bluey sale corriendo detrás de su madre cuando se va a a pasear por la playa. Por el camino, ve muchas cosas que la emocionan y la ponen a prueba. Es la primera aventura que vive sola.

Empieza la aventura en alta mar cuando Bluey, Bingo y Missy juegan a los piratas en la hamaca de los columpios. Tendrán que encontrar valor para hacer frente a fuertes tormentas y ataques de ballenas.
Bingo y Bluey se divierten jugando a las abuelitas, pero no se ponen de acuerdo en algo: ¿Saben las abuelas hacer el baile del hilo dental? Tienen que llamar a su abuela para que se lo diga.
Martin, the migratory bird, returns to camp as a refugee after his home is destroyed.
Sheriff Labrador · Series Infantiles

lista.descripcion: Lucas the Spider and his friend meet a strange creature.

lista.titulo: Baby Einstein Ocean Explorers - Let's Explore: Fish & Colors
lista.descripcion: Meet the explorers and learn about the kinds of fish in the ocean, including a blue tang!

Eddy construye un nuevo avión, pero el curioso Crong despega antes de que nadie más pueda abordar. La próxima parada es el país de los cuentos de hadas: ¡hora de conocer a Pinocho!

Daniel and his friends are playing “train” at school, but things aren’t going Katerina’s way. Meow! Katerina learns that others will not be able to help her if they don’t understand why she is upset. She finds a way to use her words and her friends find ways to help so that they can all play together!

lista.titulo: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood - The Royal Sandbox
lista.descripcion: Daniel and Prince Wednesday are making sand pies in the sandbox. They decide to top off a sand pie with Prince Tuesday's royal crown, but they soon see that this wasn’t such a good idea. They learn how to apologize to Prince Tuesday and make the situation better - by helping clean the crown and promising to ask first next time.

lista.titulo: Las aventuras de Los Elegidos - Aunque te sientas solo, no lo estás
lista.descripcion: Cuando el Día de Diversión Familiar se suspende inesperadamente, Abby lucha contra la soledad. Pero un encuentro con Jesús la ayudará a comprender que nunca estamos realmente solos.

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - A todo hielo
lista.descripcion: Cleo y sus hermanos se preparan para acampar en el jardín, pero el tiempo complica los planes. ¡No se rendirán tan fácil! ¿Lograrán levantar las tiendas en la fría nieve?

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - El circo de Cleo
lista.descripcion: Cleo tiene entradas para el circo pero, en medio del festejo, Cuquín las hace trizas. Cleo tiene una gran idea, si no pueden ir al circo, ¡lo harán ellos mismos!

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - Nos vamos de vacaciones
lista.descripcion: Cleo y sus hermanos arman las maletas para las vacaciones. Pero Cuquín tiene miedo a volar. Junto con Lara la lora, Cleo decide ayudarle a superarlo. ¿Lo conseguirá?

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - Aventura al atardecer
lista.descripcion: A la hora de acostarse, Cuquín nota que falta Ramona. ¡No puede dormir sin ella! Cleo se arma de valor: ¡irán a buscarla al jardín oscuro! ¿Qué aventuras se encontrarán?

Caillou doesn't want to eat vegetables - he wants cookies instead. Then his grandpa comes over, and they go out for a walk. Along the way, his grandpa shows him various animals and their food. Cut back to the house. They're home, and they're as hungry as bears - because they are pretending to be bears. Caillou eats his vegetables, and he's allowed to have some cookies.

lista.titulo: Caillou - El hermano mayor de Caillou
lista.descripcion: Caillou wants to play, but everybody's too busy to play with him. Caillou's Mom has to do the taxes, Caillou's Dad is repairing the washing machine, and Caillou's grandma is tucking Rosie in for her nap. Even Gilbert doesn't seem to want to play. Caillou then goes back into his room and plays with his plush toys.

lista.titulo: Blippi: Las aventuras educativas de Blippi para niños - La Canción Azul
lista.descripcion: Aprende los colores para niños con Blippi en The Blue Song. La canción azul de Blippi es una alegre canción de hip hop para ayudar a los niños a aprender los colores. Blippi hace videos educativos para niños y esta canción de Blue es una canción de colores divertida para niños.

lista.titulo: Blippi: Las aventuras educativas de Blippi para niños - Canción Del Tren
lista.descripcion: Train Song de Blippi Trains for Kids. ¡The Train Song de Blippi es un excelente video de tractores para niños! Visto por millones, a su hijo le encantará cantar y bailar las canciones infantiles de Blippi. Blippi hace videos educativos para niños en edad preescolar.

lista.titulo: Blippi: Las aventuras educativas de Blippi para niños - Canción De Los Animales Del Océano
lista.descripcion: Blippi te trae Ocean Animal Song. Aprende sobre los animales que viven bajo el océano con Blippi. ¡Blippi les enseña a los niños cosas como animales, máquinas y más! Su hijo cantará y bailará con Blippi sobre peces, tiburones, ballenas, delfines, tortugas y más animales marinos en Ocean Animal Song de Blippi.

lista.titulo: Little Baby Bum: ¡Hora de cantar! - Twinkle Twinkle Little Star / I Am a Big Apple / Jingle Bells
lista.descripcion: A familiar tune helps Twinkle get her glow back. Later, the kids learn about a Chinese string instrument called an erhu and celebrate different holidays.

lista.titulo: Little Baby Bum: ¡Hora de cantar! - Mary Had a Little Lamb / Pop Goes the Weasel / Warm Up Song
lista.descripcion: The friends have fun with high and low notes, play a silly game of jack-in-the-box, and learn how to warm up their voices on a cold, snowy day.

lista.titulo: Little Baby Bum: ¡Hora de cantar! - Five Little Ducklings / Itsy Bitsy Spider / Punchinello
lista.descripcion: Music helps Max learn to count, Maple brings her trumpet to school, and the class makes lots of different sounds - all without instruments!

lista.descripcion: The kids learn the magic of singing songs in a round, then solve a silly mystery: Where's Tootson? Max leads a march in star-shaped sunglasses.

lista.descripcion: On Halloween, the kids wear their costumes to school. Pop, pop... hop! Ahan brings bubbles to class! Timberly helps her students write a song.

Herry Monster and Sherlock Hemlock are introduced in this edition, and Farley can be glimpsed when Cookie Monster eats Big Bird's J. The Buddy and Jim segments are replaced with new segments featuring Larry and Phyllis.

lista.titulo: Pistas de Blue y tu - Playdate with Magenta
lista.descripcion: Blue’s friend Magenta is coming over today! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do with Magenta. During our search for clues, we identify opposites and check out animal footprint with our friends Shovel & Pail.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Tooth Brushing Badge
lista.descripcion: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath and teach him a special song to help him learn how to brush his teeth.
The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings.
